passage:
A train company created one silent car where phone calls and loud conversations were not allowed.
Some passengers loved it. They read, slept, or worked quietly. Others entered by mistake and were asked to lower their voices.
The company added clearer signs and announcements.
A student riding in the silent car noticed how different the journey felt. The train still moved at the same speed, but time seemed slower.
The silent car showed that public space can be divided for different needs. Some cars carry conversation. One carries quiet.
Respecting rules in shared spaces is a way of letting strangers rest.
